critique.evidence: Desktop is visually strong: dramatic headline scale, restrained grid, cohesive cyan/magenta/yellow palette, crisp ledger structure, and a clear ROI focal point. Mobile largely preserves the hierarchy, but the ledger is cramped; long currency values nearly collide and labels wrap awkwardly. Tablet has a major polish failure: the navigation bar overlays and obscures the headline and supporting copy, with menu content visibly clipped horizontally. This prevents the three-viewport presentation from being demo-ready.
critique.fix: At tablet widths, replace the desktop navigation with the mobile/condensed header or place it in normal document flow so it cannot cover content. Add responsive ledger column sizing and slightly smaller numeric type or stacked values on mobile to restore spacing between long currency figures.
